name: Flash Floors Group
owner_name_evidence: Not an official listed owner name; 'Holman' is named repeatedly by reviewers as the person who does the installation work ('The best Holman is so nice very profesional', 'Beware. Holman and workers did not completed...'), and the business's own first-person Google review replies ('Thank you very much Elizabeth', 'Thank you for contacting us') are consistent with a single owner-operator. Treated as the operator's first name for outreach personalization, not confirmed via a business registry.
street_address_note: Residential apartment, not a public storefront. Not displayed as a visitable address on the site; service area used instead, and no map embed (adapted variant, same approach as output/outside-in-handyman-portcharlotte).
email_search_notes: No public email found after checking Google Business Profile listing, web search for the business name + 'facebook'/'instagram', and domain checks. No Linktree/booking page exists to check further (none found).
own_site_checked_domains: flashfloors.com (resolves, but is a parked/for-sale domain on domains.atom.com, unrelated to this business)
own_site_check_result: CONFIRMED no own website. Google Business Profile listing has no website field (website: null from live Maps scrape). Web search for "Flash Floors Group" + Miami/Little Havana returns no matching business (only unrelated companies with similar names in other states/countries). No Facebook, Instagram or Yelp presence found via web search.
social_search_notes: Searched web for 'Flash Floors Group' + Facebook/Instagram/Yelp and variations; no matching accounts found. The business appears to operate with a Google Business Profile as its only public presence.
rating_source: Live Google Maps listing, scraped via Playwright + Chrome (scripts/maps_research.py) on 2026-11-15. Matches the rating/review count given in the task brief exactly.

hours.source: Live Google Business Profile listing (public Maps page), scraped during research.

language_evidence: Task brief suspected Spanish as the likely primary language given the business name/neighborhood, but this was explicitly verified rather than assumed, per instructions. All 5 Google reviews found (including the 1 negative one, not used on-site) are written in English, and the business owner's own first-person replies to reviews ('Thank you so much', 'Thank you very much Elizabeth', 'Thank you for contacting us', and a longer reply to a negative review) are also entirely in English. No Spanish-language reviews or owner replies were found. Primary language was therefore set to English, with Spanish as the full secondary language via the bilingual toggle.

The owner's public reply explains maple wood can stain unevenly and says the work was completed as agreed.

services_source: No published service menu, pricing page or booking platform exists for this business (Google Business Profile only, no website/Linktree/Facebook). Service categories below are derived directly from the real, verified project photos downloaded from the Google Business Profile photo gallery, not from any published list. No exact prices are published anywhere, so the site uses the adapted variant: 'free estimate, call or text' instead of listed prices.

hardwood_flooring: New hardwood floor installation (incl. wide-plank & herringbone patterns)

build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no exact pricing (free estimate, call or text), no map embed (address is a residential apartment, not a public storefront; a real finished-floor photo is used instead, same approach as output/outside-in-handyman-portcharlotte), phone/SMS-based CTA, service categories derived from real project photos instead of a published menu.
template_base: templates/light/index.html (Amani light example), re-palette to a walnut/oak accent (--accent-deep #8a5632, --accent-mid #c08a52) instead of the original mocha tones; bg/ink tokens kept the same cream/espresso base. Bilingual data-es/data-en mechanism and ES|EN nav toggle added (not present in the base template), following the pattern used in output/outside-in-handyman-portcharlotte. Lang storage uses an isolated per-site key (siteforge:lang:flash-floors-group-littlehavana) rather than a generic 'lang' key, and does not read navigator.language, per the current scripts/gate.py rules.

photos.source: Google Business Profile photo gallery (lh3.googleusercontent.com gps-cs-s URLs), downloaded live via Playwright + Chrome with a Chrome user agent (scripts/maps_research.py), verified as real JPEGs with `file`, resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82 with ImageMagick.

Finished marble-look bathroom with tile floor, shower and vanity.
Corner soaking tub with wood-panel surround and tile floor, finished.

photos.curation_notes: All photos manually reviewed one by one before selection per DESIGN.md curation rules: no selfies or portraits used as gallery tiles (the two photos showing a worker mid-task have their backs to the camera and are process shots, not portraits, and were judged acceptable; no face is visible), no blurry shots, no screenshots with text overlays.

qa_notes: Checked with Playwright + Chrome headless: no horizontal overflow at 390px viewport, no console errors, ES/EN toggle verified to swap all data-es/data-en text and <html lang>. All 9 referenced images confirmed to exist on disk.
